meta.claim_scope: published tokie vs published gigatoken per model, output, and thread config on a seeded OpenWebText subset
meta.cpu_model: AMD Ryzen AI 9 HX 370 w/ Radeon 890M

provenance.package_source: public PyPI wheels installed in a clean venv; no local checkout or path install

limitations: Per-model, per-output, per-thread comparison on a seeded OpenWebText slice; not a universal fastest-tokenizer claim.
Timing uses OpenWebText sample documents only. Edge cases and fuzz are correctness-only.
Cold reports the first call and the first full pass from a fresh instance; tokenizer.json load time is excluded. Warm rounds exclude one warmup pass.
tokie batch returns flat uint32 ids plus uint64 ends; gigatoken batch returns an awkward list array. Output shapes differ; both are counted as tokens + documents inside the timed loop.
HF tokenizers is an optional third oracle only; it is not timed here.
cProfile cannot see native kernel internals; cpu_per_wall only says whether the timed Python loop was CPU-bound.

giga_over_tokie_time.interpretation: giga seconds / tokie seconds; below 1 means giga took less time
